set.body:
Why: PairedLatentMethod / PairedMultivarEstimator admit ReducedRankRegression(YToX, ...) but the current executor/decomposition path rejects it with UnsupportedEstimator. The type is wider than the implementation, which makes unsupported runtime states constructible.

Scope: keep this item narrow. Make unsupported states unrepresentable in the public paired-method / paired-plan surface now, preferably by removing YToX until it is implemented or moving it behind a future-only type that cannot be submitted to the executor. Do not require the broader enum-dispatch or PairedGmd rewrite here; that belongs with the keystone after LatentFit and projection surfaces are normalized.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] No value constructible from the public paired-method / paired-plan API yields UnsupportedEstimator.
- [ ] A test enumerates every representable paired estimator/method case and fits each successfully.
- [ ] Any future Y-to-X RRR request is absent from public construction or represented as a typed non-executable future request, not a runnable estimator.
- [ ] JVM+JS green.
